posts.name: seesome
posts.cooked:
You can also find a PDF of the Hero and Villain prmo cards on BGG at: 

https://www.boardgamegeek.com/filepage/85258/sotm-out-print-promos-heroes-villains

I found that printing that file onto Avery 8164 labels worked well and then I just trimmed them down and stuck them onto some exat Magic land cards (the hero promos that is, the villain ones required glueing them onto cardstock).
